channel.title: Tonderai Khatai
channel.description: Software engineer with 10+ years of experience writing about system design, architecture tradeoffs, and building resilient distributed systems in Node.js and TypeScript.

item.title: Mail Koenig: A Send Queue Made Entirely of Postgres
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Sending an email campaign to a few thousand people looks simple until the third recipient’s inbox provider rate-limits you mid-send, the fourth bounces permanently, and the process doing the sending gets killed by a deploy halfway through.

item.title: Functional Core, Imperative Shell Makes Sense for Micro Apps
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Functional core, imperative shell usually gets pitched as a full architecture: pure domain functions in one layer, all I/O pushed to the edges, everything wired together through explicit ports.

item.title: Handovha: A Verifiable Handover, Without Accounts
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Memory is not a receipt. A landlord and a tenant agree a flat is fine at handover; six months later they remember it differently. A fleet manager hands over a van with a full tank and no dents; a week later, someone disputes which of those was true.

item.title: Building a Zero-Code Photography Portfolio
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Someone close to me is a photographer who needed a portfolio site but doesn’t want to touch a terminal, a code editor, or a “deploy” button.
